content.title: Market Regulation: Listings Review
content.text: Company Action Notification Form Due Date Apply to Transfer between Nasdaq Market Tiers (e.g., Global/Global Select to Capital Market, Capital Market to Global/Global Select) Log in to the Listing Center and select Listing Application Market Transfer Upon company request Cash Dividends and Other Cash Distributions Forward Stock Splits, Stock Dividends and Rights Offerings Interest Payments Log in to the Listing Center and select Dividend/ Distribution/ Interest Payment Form As soon as possible after declaration, and, in any event, no later than simultaneously with the public disclosure and no later than 10 calendar days prior to record date Change in Company Name Change in Security Title or Par Value Log in to the Listing Center and select Company Event Notification No later than 10 calendar days after the change Change in State of Incorporation or Place of Organization Change Requiring Updated Corporate Governance Certification or Listing Agreement Log in to the Listing Center and select Company Event Notification As soon as practicable after change Change in Trading Symbol Log in to the Listing Center and select Company Event Notification No later than two business days prior to desired change Change in Transfer Agent or Registrar Noncompliance with Corporate Governance Rules Email notification to continuedlisting@nasdaq.com At time of occurrence Check Payments Submit completed Check Payment Form along with payment If payment is made by wire, this form is not necessary Payment due dates vary based on fee type Formation of a Holding Company that Replaces a Listed Company or Listing a New Class of Securities in Substitution for a Previously Listed Class of Securities Reverse Stock Split Log in to the Listing Center and select Company Event Notification No later than 15 calendar days prior to effective date Hearing Request Log in to the Listing Center and select Hearing Request Form No later than 7 calendar days following Staff Determination Increase or Decrease of 5% or More in the Number of Shares Outstanding Log in to the Listing Center and select Change in Shares Outstanding No later than 10 calendar days after occurrence Investment Management Entity and Portfolio Company Certification Submit completed Certification Form No later than December 31 of current year Listing of Additional Shares Log in to the Listing Center and select Listing of Additional Shares No later than 15 calendar days prior to the share issuance Listing a New Class of Securities Log in to the Listing Center and select Listing Application Seeking to List a New Class of Securities No later than 30 calendar days prior to the anticipated first trade date Mergers Email notification to nasdaqreorgs@nasdaq.com Prior to declaring the shareholder meeting date Redemptions/Extensions of Derivative Securities Email notification to continuedlisting@nasdaq.com Prior to declaring the shareholder meeting date Request Rule Interpretation Log in to the Listing Center and select Rule Interpretation Request Upon company request Tender Offers Email notification to nasdaqreorgs@nasdaq.com As soon as practicable
